decision_kinds.description: Decision kind -> id prefix; without it decision ids are DEC-nnn

sdd.description: Project parameters of the SDD process (KIT-067). An absent key takes its default; sdd-constitution/references/sdd-parameters.md names the step that reads each key; check_spec.py --params prints the resolved block

needs.description: NEED-nnn intake records under docs/spec/needs/; read by sdd-intake, sdd-specify, sdd-clarify

journeys.description: J-nn journeys under docs/spec/journeys/; read by sdd-clarify, sdd-check, sync-project.sh; absent = on when the folder exists

tracker.description: Where task rows are cut: GitHub issues, or none (task files in the repository); read by sdd-tasks, sdd-implement, sdd-spike

plan_sections.description: The FEAT ## Plan subsections this project fills; Risks and Tests are always on; read by sdd-plan

pr_unit.description: One PR per task row or one per FEAT; read by sdd-implement

task_minutes.description: Upper size of a task row for one fresh agent context, in minutes; read by sdd-tasks

row_check.description: Project command that checks the task rows before the cut; null = the kit row checks (row_checks.py, KIT-073); read by sdd-tasks

cut_command.description: Project command that cuts the approved rows; null = the kit cut; read by sdd-tasks

max_chain.description: Longest dependency chain allowed among a FEAT's task rows; read by sdd-tasks

max_feat_tasks.description: Task rows above which a FEAT is too large for one delivery: check_spec.py warns and sdd-plan splits the NEED into several FEATs; read by sdd-plan, sdd-tasks

release.description: merge: a FEAT is delivered once its work is on main (after its sdd-review closure, KIT-069); manual: sdd-release delivers it; read by sdd-review, sdd-release

review_rounds.description: NOT READY rounds on one criterion before the owner decides; read by review

commits_by.description: Who commits a task's work: the executor session or the orchestrator; read by sdd-implement

protected_paths.description: Path or glob -> label a change to it needs; read by sdd-tasks and review

bundle.description: Limits for one issue that bundles task rows sharing a Files path; rows 1 = one issue per row; read by sdd-tasks

points.description: Sum of the rows' Complexity, Low 1, Med 2, High 3

rule_paths.description: Kit rule name -> folders its globs are scoped to, '.' for the whole repository; wins over the --profile folders; read by sync-project.sh

visual_approval.description: Who approves a screen or motion change's captures against its REQ's mock before the merge: the owner, the reviewer, or none (no visual approval step); read by review (KIT-069) and by row_checks.py rule j, which is off unless it is owner or reviewer

components.description: Component name -> its folder in this repository, '.' for the root: a Files entry or test path may start with either; one task row stays in one component. Read by row_checks.py (rules b, c, e, g, i, j, k) and spec_trace.py (journey test paths)

spec_index.description: spec_trace.py check fails when docs/spec/spec.md lacks a linked table row for a functional or non-functional REQ file or a journey file, or links a missing one

github.description: Where spec_trace.py sync-status reads task issues and their PRs (tracker: github only)

repo.description: owner/name of the backlog repository that holds the task issues; null = the origin remote

pr_repos.description: Other owner/name repositories whose PRs close backlog issues

aliases.description: Earlier owner/name names of the backlog repository that a Closes line may still use

blocked_labels.description: Issue labels that make a row blocked

progress_labels.description: Issue labels that make a row doing without an open PR

row_checks.description: Inputs of the kit row checks (row_checks.py, KIT-073); a rule whose input is null or empty is off; sdd-tasks/references/row-checks.md names each rule

gates.description: Repository path of the PR gates JSON (pr_gates.py): proof_allowlist, proof_script_runners, generated_neighbours (rules d, e, g)

tests.description: Rule c, per stack: a Files entry matching a code glob (minus exclude) needs an entry matching or covering the tests glob ($1.. are the code glob's wildcards); level fail or warn

assets.description: Rule d: an exact Files path under paths ending in one of suffixes needs a covering directory glob

protocol.description: Rules h and k: the contract folder, the message schema folder (<type>.json) and each consumer's generated tables

evidence_only.description: Rule e: true lets a row whose Proof holds only evidence: clauses pass with no runnable clause; false fails it (KIT-080)

artifacts.description: Rule i: repository path of the artifact policy registry, a JSON list of {pattern, dec, policy}

visual.description: Rule j (with visual_approval owner or reviewer): Files paths that change a screen or motion, paths to ignore, and the evidence catalog file per kind ($id)

owner_approvals.description: Change kinds only the owner may approve, for example decision, approved-dec-change, protocol-version, in-game-evidence; read by review (KIT-069) and an orchestrator session under owner-review autonomy

doc_structure.description: The README and done/INDEX.md check (check_docs_structure.py, KIT-074), opt-in; read by the check itself, which the docs just module and the spec-tools action run

enabled.description: Run the check: just lint and the spec-tools action run the kit's check_docs_structure.py, which passes as off while false

exempt.description: File of fnmatch globs (one per line, from the repository root) for folders a parent README covers

headings.description: Headings every folder README carries after its # title

done_index.description: Every done/ folder has an INDEX.md naming each direct child
